page.layout: One page of text with running head at top and page number at top right. Above the rule: two paragraphs of continuing text, one of them italic. Below the rule: a numbered chapter heading, then body text with a large initial C. No marginal notes. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: illum cultum tibi exhibeat denuo: in omnibus illis sanctis officiis, quae Sacrosanctae tuae Doctrinae consentiant & exemplo in primis imitando.

p.i: Experti, in hac nostra Dissipatione, & Eclypsi; quam vana prorsus & fluxa est Humana omnis Gloria, & Magnitudo, eò Studiosius ambiamus perpetuis illis Honoribus, & Perfectione potiri, quam in Te solum invenire fas est, & per Iesum Christum acquirere.

main_text.head: 3. De Exclusione Regis ad Hullam urbem, & Hothamiorum fatis.
main_text.p: CUm ab Hulla excluderer, visum est primâ facie tam insolens facinus, & aperta obsequii Detrectatio, ut Ipsi mei Inimici vix auderent tanquam suum agnoscere. Erat hoc quidem Primum illis Patientiae meae Tentamen, quàm scilicet æquo possem animo Spoliari Regnis.
Quo tamen (Deus novit) non tam Ira

page.notes: The page number is printed in old-style figures ("4ȝ"); read as 43. The Greek running head is read as ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ; the final letter is printed in a form close to H and may be a Greek eta. The initial "Vm" is read as "Um" (u printed as V), giving CUm. No marginal notes or footnotes are printed on this page.
